title: Postoperative bleeding
banner: DRAFT, NOT clinically reviewed. Fictional scenario specification; never imported, published or shown to learners.
learning_objectives: Monitor for bleeding in anticoagulated or post-operative patients and report it.

expected_actions.text: Watch for bleeding at any site in patients receiving heparin or enoxaparin and report it at once.
Report new back pain or leg weakness after neuraxial procedures in anticoagulated patients.

gaps: No published clinical scenario may exist until the review phase: this is a specification only.
